<p style="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">Item 5.02 Departure of Directors or Certain
Officers; Election of Directors; Appointment of Certain Officers; Compensatory Arrangements of Certain Officers.</p>

<p style="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><i>Retirement of Mr. Carrasco</i></p>

<p style="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><span style="font-weight: normal">On
May 8, 2026, Mr. Rafael E. Carrasco, Senior Vice President, Enterprise Strategy and President, WM Healthcare Solutions of Waste Management,&#160;Inc.
(the &#8220;Company&#8221;), provided notice of his decision to retire as of July 17, 2026. The Company is grateful to Mr. Carrasco for
his 10 years of dedicated service to the Company in a range of operational leadership roles, including his recent leadership over the
Stericycle, Inc. acquisition and the successful integration and development of the Company&#8217;s healthcare solutions business.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><i>Promotion of Ms. Hemmer</i></p>

<p style="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white; text-indent: 0.5in">On
May 13, 2026, the Company announced that its Board of Directors (the &#8220;Board&#8221;) has promoted Ms. Tara J. Hemmer to the position
of Executive Vice President and Chief Operating Officer, reporting to President John J. Morris, Jr. Mr. Morris voluntarily resigned from
the position of Chief Operating Officer. <span style="background-color: white">Ms. Hemmer, age 53, has served as the Company&#8217;s Senior
Vice President and Chief Sustainability Officer since 2021. </span>Ms. Hemmer does not have any interest in transactions required to be
disclosed pursuant to Item 404(a) of Regulation S-K.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white; text-indent: 0.5in">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white; text-indent: 0.5in"><span style="background-color: white">In
connection with Ms. Hemmer&#8217;s promotion, her annual base salary has been increased to $850,000, and her target annual cash incentive
will be 105% of her base salary in effect at year end. </span>Additionally, the Management Development and Compensation Committee of the
Board approved an award of restricted stock units (&#8220;RSUs&#8221;) under the Company&#8217;s 2023 Stock Incentive Plan with a grant
date of May 20, 2026 and a value of $575,000. The number of RSUs granted will be calculated by dividing such value by the average of the
high and low price of the Company&#8217;s common stock over the 30 trading days preceding the grant date. Key terms of the RSUs are described
below.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white; text-indent: 0.5in">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<table cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; background-color: white; border-collapse: collapse">
  <tr>
    <td style="vertical-align: top; width: 27%; font-size: 10pt; text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 10pt"><b><span style="text-decoration: underline">RSUs</span></b></span></td>
    <td style="vertical-align: bottom; width: 3%; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify">&#160;</td>
    <td style="vertical-align: bottom; width: 70%">&#160;</td></tr>
  <tr>
    <td style="text-align: left">&#160;</td>
    <td colspan="2">&#160;</td></tr>
  <tr>
    <td style="vertical-align: top; font-size: 10pt; text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 10pt">The &#8220;Vesting Dates&#8221;</span></td>
    <td style="vertical-align: bottom; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify">&#160;</td>
    <td style="vertical-align: top">34% on the first anniversary of grant <br/>
33% on the second anniversary of grant <br/>
33% on the third anniversary of grant <br/>
Each RSU will be converted into one share of Company common stock upon vesting.</td></tr>
  <tr>
    <td style="text-align: left">&#160;</td>
    <td colspan="2">&#160;</td></tr>
  <tr>
    <td style="vertical-align: top; font-size: 10pt; text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 10pt">Dividend Equivalents</span></td>
    <td style="vertical-align: bottom; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify">&#160;</td>
    <td style="vertical-align: top; font-size: 10pt; text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 10pt">Dividends will accrue and be paid in cash upon any payout of RSUs.</span></td></tr>
  <tr>
    <td style="text-align: left">&#160;</td>
    <td colspan="2">&#160;</td></tr>
  <tr>
    <td style="vertical-align: top; font-size: 10pt; text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 10pt">Termination of Employment</span></td>
    <td style="vertical-align: bottom; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify">&#160;</td>
    <td style="vertical-align: top">&#160;</td></tr>
  <tr>
    <td style="text-align: left">&#160;</td>
    <td colspan="2">&#160;</td></tr>
  <tr>
    <td style="padding-left: 0.25in; vertical-align: top; font-size: 10pt; text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 10pt">Death or Disability</span></td>
    <td style="vertical-align: bottom; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify">&#160;</td>
    <td style="text-align: justify; vertical-align: top; font-size: 10pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">All unvested RSUs will vest and be issued and paid following the date of such death or disability.</span></td></tr>
  <tr>
    <td style="text-align: left">&#160;</td>
    <td colspan="2">&#160;</td></tr>
  <tr>
    <td style="text-align: left; padding-left: 0.25in; vertical-align: top">Retirement (as defined in the award agreement)</td>
    <td style="vertical-align: bottom; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify">&#160;</td>
    <td style="text-align: justify; vertical-align: top">If Retirement occurs after January 1, 2027, all RSUs will vest and be issued and paid following the normal Vesting Dates. (The earliest date that Ms. Hemmer will potentially be eligible for Retirement is October 2027.) </td></tr>
  <tr>
    <td style="text-align: left; padding-left: 0.25in; vertical-align: top">&#160;</td>
    <td style="vertical-align: bottom; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify">&#160;</td>
    <td style="text-align: justify; vertical-align: top">&#160;</td></tr>
  <tr>
    <td style="text-align: left; padding-left: 0.25in; vertical-align: top"> Involuntary Termination without Cause</td>
    <td style="vertical-align: bottom; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify">&#160;</td>
    <td style="text-align: justify; vertical-align: top">RSUs equal to the total number of unvested RSUs, prorated based on the portion of the entire three-year vesting period that the employee was employed, will vest and be issued and paid following the normal Vesting Dates. </td></tr>
  <tr>
    <td style="text-align: left; padding-left: 0.25in; vertical-align: top">&#160;</td>
    <td style="vertical-align: bottom; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify">&#160;</td>
    <td style="vertical-align: top">&#160;</td></tr>
  <tr>
    <td style="text-align: left; padding-left: 0.25in; vertical-align: top">Resignation; Involuntary Termination for Cause &#160;</td>
    <td style="vertical-align: bottom; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify">&#160;</td>
    <td style="vertical-align: top">All unvested RSUs are forfeited.</td></tr>
  <tr>
    <td style="text-align: left">&#160;</td>
    <td colspan="2">&#160;</td></tr>
  <tr>
    <td style="padding-left: 0.25in; vertical-align: top; font-size: 10pt; text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 10pt">Involuntary Termination without Cause following a Change in Control</span></td>
    <td style="vertical-align: bottom; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify">&#160;</td>
    <td style="vertical-align: top; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-size: 10pt">All unvested RSUs will vest and be issued and paid following the normal Vesting Dates.</span></td></tr>
  </table>

<p style="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>
